translation.name: Cartagena
translation.summary: Cartagena stands on Colombia’s Caribbean coast. Its UNESCO-listed historic centre, old fortifications, beaches and nearby coral reefs make it a favourite stop for culture and seaside travel.

translation.body:
Cartagena de Indias is a historic port city on Colombia’s Caribbean coast. Its old centre, recognised by UNESCO, is famous for colourful houses, balconies, churches, museums and substantial fortifications.

The city’s trading history is visible in its colonial architecture and waterfront. Walk along cobbled streets, visit the old fortifications and explore the atmosphere of its lively squares. Cartagena is also known for its restaurants, local cooking, music and evening life.

The Caribbean coast adds a different side to the journey. Sandy beaches, clear water and nearby coral reefs attract travellers interested in a relaxed beach stay or diving. The Playa Blanca area and island excursions can complement a few days in the old town.

Ada Tours can combine Cartagena’s historic sights with time by the sea and continue the itinerary through other parts of Colombia.
